sentences.japanese: 僕が君と一緒に住んだことは君の人生観に影響を与えたと思う。
sentences.english: I think my living with you has influenced your way of living.

sentences.japanese: やめて！あなたは彼女に不快感を与えている！
sentences.english: Stop it! You're making her feel uncomfortable!

sentences.japanese: 想像力は私たちの生活のどの側面にも影響を与える。
sentences.english: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.

sentences.japanese: 私の持っている全てをあなたに与えるために時間をちょうだい。
sentences.english: Give me time to give you everything I have!

sentences.japanese: １インチを与えると１ヤードを取ろうとする。
sentences.english: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.
